name: tienkung3
notes: Humanoid with no gripper: left_tcp/right_tcp are rigid meshes, no hand joints/sites/actuators. Must attach Robotiq 2F-85 to right wrist_roll_r_link (end of right arm chain). Tool +z is finger direction, wrist outward is -z in wrist body frame, so attach quat 180deg about X [0,1,0,0] maps tool +z to wrist -z, pos 0 0 -0.06 just beyond wrist origin/tcp. ee_site tool/pinch, gripper tool/fingers_actuator open 0 closed 255 per tool doc. approach +z (palm to fingertips along tool +z), closing +y guessed for 2F-85 parallel closure (unsure, could be x). active is right-arm pos_ actuators only. fixed_base true, humanoid behind table x=-0.35, pelvis 0+1 +0.75+bz, foot offset ~-0.975 gives bz=-0.775 for feet at z=0. home raises right arm forward (shoulder_pitch -1 about +y moves -z arm toward +x) with elbow -0.6 bend, legs/waist zero for standing, hand should be ~1.3m high above table. Unsure about exact standing height, disabled pos groups (0,1,3) vs motor torque group, and 2F85 closing axis sign.
